description: After independently performing a fresh paid search, scrape, browser extraction, API read or other source-backed validation, deposit the observed result for later CHECKs. Returns accepted=true when a new observation is stored or deduplicated=true for a recognized retry/recent duplicate. Never OBSERVE hearsay. Optional Ed25519 proof establishes key possession and continuity, not truth or real-world independence.

evidence_fingerprint.description: Optional caller-supplied fingerprint of the independently obtained evidence. SeenRelay stores it as provenance metadata and does not verify it against the source.

fact.description: Source-backed fact coordinate for the independently obtained observation.

locator.description: Stable source-native locator. Prefer this when the source exposes one.

scheme.description: Source-native locator type: RFC 6901-style JSON pointer, stable HTML element id, or stable source-native key.

value.description: Source-native locator value. json_pointer values must begin with /; locator bytes are otherwise preserved.

predicate.description: Stable shared machine identifier; identity-bearing only when locator is absent.

qualifiers.description: Identity-bearing semantic qualifiers. Include only fields needed to distinguish otherwise identical source-backed facts.

source.description: Stable credential-free absolute HTTP(S) source URL. Tracking parameters are removed; authentication or signature query parameters are rejected.

subject.description: Human-readable label; excluded from canonical fact identity.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen retry key for the same OBSERVE operation. Reusing it deduplicates an idempotent retry.

observed_at.description: ISO-8601 time when the caller obtained the observation. Omit to use server receipt time.

observer_id.description: Optional self-asserted continuity label. It is unverified unless accompanied by observer_proof.

observer_proof.description: Optional Ed25519 proof of key possession, continuity and payload integrity; not proof of truth or real-world independence.

nonce.description: 16..64 random bytes encoded as unpadded base64url.

public_key.description: Raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key encoded as unpadded base64url.

signature.description: Raw 64-byte Ed25519 signature encoded as unpadded base64url.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 signing time; it must fall within the configured proof-skew window.

source_validator.description: Optional source-validator metadata from the independent validation. The caller decides whether a returned hint is sufficient for source confirmation.

value.description: Observer-supplied validator value. Stored and returned only as a hint; SeenRelay does not verify it against the source.
Value independently obtained by the caller. Mutable observed content is excluded from fact identity.

name: observe_fact

outputSchema.description: OBSERVE result. accepted=true means a new observation was stored; deduplicated=true means the retry/recent duplicate was recognized.

accepted.description: True when a new independently obtained observation was stored. Omitted when OBSERVE cannot be admitted.

deduplicated.description: True when an idempotent/recent duplicate was recognized and no new observation row was needed.

error.description: Present when OBSERVE cannot be admitted or is controlled. This is not a statement about source truth.

detail.description: Human-readable error detail. A tool error is not evidence that the source value is unchanged.

fact_key.description: Canonical SeenRelay fact identity for this coordinate.

future_check_eligible.description: Whether the accepted or deduplicated observation is eligible to support later CHECKs under normal freshness rules.

reason.description: Deduplication reason when accepted=false and deduplicated=true.

title: Contribute Fact Observation
